name: HC42d: IMC
description:
Clients newly enrolled in IMC during the reporting quarter
Number of clients whose first documented enrolment into a Differentiated Service Delivery Model during the reporting period was Individual Models based in the Community.
The client must have a DSDM record during the reporting period, the recorded model must be IMC - Individual model based in community, and there must be no earlier non-null DSDM model for that patient.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
configJson:
{

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT h.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_health_education h
WHERE h.encounter_datetime BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  AND h.dsdm_models = 'IMC - Individual model based in community'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_health_education h2
      WHERE h2.patient_id = h.patient_id
        AND h2.encounter_datetime < h.encounter_datetime
        AND h2.dsdm_models IS NOT NULL
  );
